item.title: macOS 27: Workaround to avoid downloading AI models and save storage
GitLab Duo Expands Self-Hosted AI Options Through Microsoft Foundry
item.description: GitLab has expanded GitLab Duo Self-Hosted to support models deployed through Microsoft Foundry, letting organizations run GitLab's AI development capabilities against models hosted in their chosen Azure environment. By Craig Risi (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AI Has No Wisdom and Neither Will You
Cloudflare Introduces the Agent Development Stack Lifecycle to Replace Traditional SDLC
item.description: Cloudflare has introduced the Agent Development Lifecycle to enhance AI-driven engineering. The approach replaces the traditional SDLC, addressing bottlenecks in testing, deployment, and maintenance. (1 source: infoq)
